app_info.subtitle: Santander public transport
app_info.description: TUS Santander helps users find city bus stops, ordered routes, recent vehicle positions, arrival estimates, recharge points, and current TUeBICI station availability using official municipal and operator data.

test_cases.description: Find a Santander bus stop by its public stop number and render it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find Santander TUS bus stop 15 and show it on a map.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns stop 15 with its current official details and displays it as a clickable pin on an interactive map.

test_cases.description: Check the latest published arrivals for a specific stop and line.
test_cases.user_prompt: When is line 1 arriving at Santander bus stop 15?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the latest matching arrival estimates with destinations, times, distances, and observation timestamps.

test_cases.description: Handle a nonexistent line without fabricating transit information.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the stops for Santander bus line NOT-A-LINE.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a clear tool error explaining that the line does not exist in the official dataset.

test_cases.description: Find and render recently observed Santander buses.
test_cases.user_prompt: Where are the active buses on Santander line 1 right now? Show them on a map.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the newest recent observation per vehicle with line and vehicle metadata, then displays those buses on an interactive map.

test_cases.description: Compare nearby TUS recharge points and available TUeBICI stations.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show TUS recharge points near the Sardinero and TUeBICI stations that have bicycles available right now.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching official recharge points and currently available TUeBICI stations, displaying each result set on its interactive map.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for bus information outside Santander.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: When does the next EMT Madrid bus arrive?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it only supports Santander TUS data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated Santander tourism requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Recommend three seafood restaurants in Santander.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because restaurant recommendations are outside its supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to purchase transport tickets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy me a TUS bus ticket for tomorrow.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot buy tickets or perform transactions.
